About This Hackathon

Your phone is on Do Not Disturb. Your agent isn't. A 32-hour hackathon (Nov 12-13) at Entrepreneurs First, 501 Folsom St, SF, where 100 builders teach AI agents to use the phone. Teams of 1 to 3, everything must be accessible from a phone. $3,000 in cash prizes. Hosted by Entrepreneurs First, in partnership with LangChain.
